question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 5.
solution:
The correct answer is '**on**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase "placed on the land" is the correct usage here, as it refers to placing demands or burdens on something (in this case, the land), which fits the context of agricultural demands leading to soil erosion.
 
• "On" is used to indicate the target or recipient of an action, and in this context, it suggests the new demands that are being imposed or placed on the land.
 
• Other options ("in", "by", "of") do not fit the context as naturally as "on". "In" would imply being inside or within something, which does not convey the idea of placing demands on land. "By" and "of" would also be grammatically incorrect in this context.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 1**'.

 

Complete Passage: *Erosion of America's farmland by wind and water (1)_____ a problem since settlers first put the prairies and grasslands (2)______ the plow in the 19th century. By the 1930s, more than 282 million acres of farmland were (3)______ by erosion. After 40 years of conservation efforts, soil erosion has (4)________ due to new demands placed (5) on__ the land by heavy crop production.*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• "On" is the most appropriate preposition to indicate that the demands are being placed or imposed upon the land, which is the intended meaning in the passage.
 
• "In", "by", and "of" are not correct in this context, as they do not convey the idea of imposing demands or pressures on the land.
